title: BioLegend Human IL-2 ELISA MAX Deluxe Set Protocol
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Verify tips and sample plate
steps.instruction: Robot pauses; confirm that a 20 µL tip rack and the current sample plate are placed on the deck.

steps.title: Add Assay Diluent A
steps.instruction: Using the 8‑channel P300, pick up 7 tips, dispense 90 µL of 1× Assay Diluent A into rows A‑G of the ELISA plate, then return the tips to the box for reuse on the next plate.

substeps.instruction: Pick up 7 tips with the P300
Dispense 90 µL 1× Assay Diluent A into rows A‑G of the ELISA plate
Return tips to the tip box for reuse

steps.title: Load row H tips
steps.instruction: Load the P300 with tips from row H of the empty tip box in slot 9, using columns 2‑12 of the tip box in slot 11 as the source.

steps.title: Add standards to ELISA
steps.instruction: Using the front‑most channel of the P300 with a single tip, transfer 100 µL of standard from row H of the sample plate to row H of the ELISA plate.

steps.title: Add samples to ELISA
steps.instruction: Using the 8‑channel P20, dispense 10 µL of each sample into rows A‑G of the ELISA plate.
